before: The network has four retained-parent choices. The proof derives each corresponding Fourier monomial from the actual graph, including branches with no observed descendants, and averages them with the inheritance weights.

Special algebraic edge parameters make that averaged expression factor exactly into the three edge contributions of a tree. Exact ordinary-state Markov pruning provides a separate way to compare every pattern probability.

Nonzero Jacobian minors show that the unrestricted theta map is locally onto its effective Fourier space. The preimage and constant-rank theorems then give the collision dimensions and nearby tree coverage; an implicit-function argument moves into strict continuous-time chambers.
Attaching the same three conditional Markov subtrees applies the same linear map to both equal interface distributions. This preserves equality on any number of leaves after one theta insertion.
